title: Execute elevated applet request, protocol execute.elevated_applet/1
description: The one-object request that `execute` writes to the standard input of the elevated helper for a single applet call. It names exactly one applet and a JSON object of its arguments. Keys are written in sorted order, so the same request always gives the same bytes. The helper refuses any other top-level key, a repeated key, a different protocol or a different version.

applet.description: Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, underscore and dot, within the applet name length limit.

arguments.description: The applet arguments, keyed by parameter name. Path arguments are absolute and free of '..' by the time the helper runs them.
